mapper.select: SELECT id, investigation_id, result_type, root_cause_id, root_cause, evidence_ids, unresolved_questions, summary, created_at FROM conclusion WHERE investigation_id = #{investigationId} ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO conclusion (investigation_id, result_type, root_cause_id, root_cause, evidence_ids, unresolved_questions, summary) VALUES (#{investigationId}, #{resultType}, #{rootCauseId}, #{rootCause}, #{evidenceIds}, #{unresolvedQuestions}, #{summary})
